description: Bucket-brigade delay modelled on an analogue memory delay pedal, with chorus and vibrato modulation of the delay clock, a compander, and the hiss and clock bleed of the original circuit

params.text: Sets the drive into the modelled preamp and compander, so higher settings add saturation before the delay
Fades between the direct signal and the delayed one, on a law that lifts the middle so the level does not drop there
Sets how much of the delayed signal is returned to the input for repeats; high settings bloom into self-oscillation
Sets the delay time by setting the bucket-brigade clock period, about 33ms fully anticlockwise to about 410ms fully clockwise, or 819ms in the long range; moving it bends the repeats
Sets how far the chorus or vibrato modulation moves the delay clock
Chooses chorus or vibrato: chorus modulates at about 0.35Hz in the middle of the delay range and vibrato at about 1.65Hz, and shorter delay times raise both
Chooses the modulation wave, a triangle in one position and a square in the other; the square steps the delay time between two values
Engages the effect in the upper position and bypasses it in the lower, despite the panel printing BYPASS beside it; bypassed, the input comes out untouched
Doubles the longest delay time, from about 410ms to about 819ms
Scales the Level CV input before it is added to the LEVEL knob, backwards at negative settings
Scales the Blend CV input before it is added to the BLEND knob, backwards at negative settings
Scales the Feedback CV input before it is added to the FEED knob, backwards at negative settings
Scales the Delay CV input before it is added to the delay time, backwards at negative settings
Scales the Depth CV input before it is added to the DEPTH knob, backwards at negative settings

inputs.text: The signal to be delayed; each channel of a polyphonic cable gets its own delay engine, up to sixteen
Adds to the LEVEL knob after the trimpot for this jack scales it, 5V covering the whole range at a trimpot fully clockwise
Adds to the BLEND knob after the trimpot for this jack scales it, 5V covering the whole range at a trimpot fully clockwise
Adds to the FEED knob after the trimpot for this jack scales it, 5V covering the whole range at a trimpot fully clockwise
Adds to the delay time after the trimpot for this jack scales it, 5V covering the whole range at a trimpot fully clockwise, whether the knob or the tapped tempo is setting that time
Adds to the DEPTH knob after the trimpot for this jack scales it, 5V covering the whole range at a trimpot fully clockwise
Chooses vibrato above 1V and chorus below it while patched, in place of the CH/VB switch
Chooses the square modulation wave above 1V and the triangle below it while patched, in place of the TRI/SQ switch
Engages the effect above 1V and bypasses it below while patched, in place of the BYPASS switch
Chooses the long delay range above 1V and the normal range below it while patched, in place of the RANGE switch
Sets the delay time from the interval between rising edges above 2V, taking taps between 0.08 and 4 seconds apart, and switches the menu's Timing to the tapped setting

outputs.text: The direct and delayed signals mixed by the BLEND control, one channel per input channel, or two when a mono input is spread by one of the stereo modes
The input signal passed through untouched, for parallel patching
The delayed signal on its own, before the BLEND control
The LEVEL control's value after its CV and trimpot, as 0V to 10V
The BLEND control's value after its CV and trimpot, as 0V to 10V
The FEED control's value after its CV and trimpot, as 0V to 10V
The delay time as a proportion of the current range after its CV and trimpot, as 0V to 10V
The DEPTH control's value after its CV and trimpot, as 0V to 10V
10V while vibrato is chosen and 0V while chorus is
The modulation wave itself, triangle or square as chosen, swinging between -5V and 5V
10V while the effect is engaged and 0V while it is bypassed
10V while the long delay range is chosen and 0V while the normal range is
A square wave at the bucket-brigade clock divided by 64, switching between 0V and 10V, so it speeds up as the delay time shortens
A square wave at the bucket-brigade clock divided by 512, switching between 0V and 10V, so it speeds up as the delay time shortens
The modelled compander's envelope as 0V to 10V, rising with the level going into the delay

notes: the DELAY knob does nothing while the menu's Timing is set to Tap/sync delay: the tapped tempo and division set the time, and the Delay CV is added to that
a stereo mode other than Mono pedal spreads a mono input over two channels only while the effect is engaged
tapping the Tap input switches the menu's Timing to Tap/sync delay on its own, which takes the DELAY knob out of circuit
menu: Artifact profile: Cleaner BBD, Rev_D authentic, Worn unit — sets how much hiss, clock bleed and drift the delay adds
Bypass behavior: Trails, CPU mute — chooses whether the delay memory keeps running while the effect is bypassed, or is cleared and the processing skipped
Timing: Free delay knob, Tap/sync delay — chooses whether the DELAY knob sets the time or the tapped tempo and division do
Division: 1/1, 1/2, 1/4., 1/4, 1/8., 1/8, 1/8T, 1/16 — on the Timing submenu, sets the note value of the tapped tempo that the delay time takes
Tap tempo seed: 60 BPM, 90 BPM, 120 BPM, 140 BPM — on the Timing submenu, sets a tempo without tapping and switches Timing to the tapped setting
Stereo mode: Mono pedal, Wide chorus, Ping-pong offset — chooses whether a mono input is spread over two channels, and how far the second channel's delay and modulation are offset
Advanced calibration — seven trims over input gain, bucket-brigade bias, clock bleed, compander, noise, wet makeup and feedback headroom, each from off to 200 per cent of normal
Reset calibration trims — returns all seven calibration trims to 100 per cent
Clear delay memory — empties the delay buffer, cutting off repeats and any self-oscillation
